# Gandi NS
> Gandi NS provides DNS hosting and nameserver management services for domains, with documentation and support resources for configuration and operations.

Gandi NS is part of Gandi's domain and DNS infrastructure, offering authoritative nameserver services and related domain name system guidance through Gandi's documentation and support content.

## DNS Documentation
- [DNS documentation](https://docs.gandi.net/en/domain_names/common_operations/dns/): Overview of DNS concepts and common DNS operations in Gandi documentation.
- [Manage DNS records](https://docs.gandi.net/en/domain_names/common_operations/dns_records.html): Instructions for creating and editing common DNS record types.
- [Glue records](https://docs.gandi.net/en/domain_names/register/glue_records.html): Explains host objects and glue record configuration for nameservers.
- [Nameservers](https://docs.gandi.net/en/domain_names/common_operations/nameservers.html): Guidance for changing and managing authoritative nameservers on domains.
- [DNSSEC](https://docs.gandi.net/en/domain_names/common_operations/dnssec.html): Documentation for enabling and managing DNSSEC on supported domains.

## Domain Name Operations
- [Domain names documentation](https://docs.gandi.net/en/domain_names/): Entry point for domain registration, transfer, and management documentation.
- [Register a domain](https://docs.gandi.net/en/domain_names/register/): Documentation for registering new domain names with Gandi.
- [Transfer a domain](https://docs.gandi.net/en/domain_names/transfer/): Guides for inbound domain transfers and related requirements.
- [Renew a domain](https://docs.gandi.net/en/domain_names/renew/): Information about domain renewal workflows and lifecycle handling.
- [Domain contacts](https://docs.gandi.net/en/domain_names/common_operations/contact_management.html): Explains contact management for domain ownership and administration.

## API Reference
- [Gandi API documentation](https://api.gandi.net/docs/): Main reference for Gandi's public API endpoints and usage.
- [Domain API](https://api.gandi.net/docs/domains/): API reference for domain management operations and resources.
- [DNS API](https://api.gandi.net/docs/livedns/): API reference for LiveDNS zones, records, and nameserver-related automation.
- [Authentication](https://api.gandi.net/docs/authentication/): Details on API keys and authentication methods for Gandi services.
- [OpenAPI specification](https://api.gandi.net/docs/openapi/): Machine-readable API schema and endpoint definitions.

## LiveDNS Guides
- [LiveDNS overview](https://docs.gandi.net/en/livedns/): Overview of Gandi LiveDNS features and service behavior.
- [Create a zone](https://docs.gandi.net/en/livedns/create_a_zone.html): Steps for creating and initializing a DNS zone.
- [Edit DNS records in LiveDNS](https://docs.gandi.net/en/livedns/edit_dns_records.html): How to add, modify, and remove records in a zone.
- [Import a zone file](https://docs.gandi.net/en/livedns/import_zone_file.html): Instructions for importing existing DNS configurations from zone files.
- [Export a zone file](https://docs.gandi.net/en/livedns/export_zone_file.html): Explains how to export DNS zone data for backup or migration.

## Email and Related DNS Setup
- [Email documentation](https://docs.gandi.net/en/mail/): Documentation for Gandi mail services and related administration.
- [MX records](https://docs.gandi.net/en/domain_names/common_operations/dns_records/mx_record.html): Explains MX record usage for directing mail delivery.
- [SPF records](https://docs.gandi.net/en/domain_names/common_operations/dns_records/spf_record.html): Guidance for publishing SPF policies in DNS.
- [DKIM records](https://docs.gandi.net/en/domain_names/common_operations/dns_records/dkim_record.html): Documentation for DKIM-related DNS record configuration.
- [DMARC records](https://docs.gandi.net/en/domain_names/common_operations/dns_records/dmarc_record.html): Guidance for adding DMARC policies to DNS zones.

## SSL and Security
- [SSL certificates documentation](https://docs.gandi.net/en/ssl/): Documentation for certificate ordering, validation, and management.
- [DNSSEC documentation](https://docs.gandi.net/en/domain_names/common_operations/dnssec.html): Security guidance for signing domains with DNSSEC.
- [Two-factor authentication](https://docs.gandi.net/en/account_security/two_factor_authentication.html): Instructions for securing Gandi accounts with 2FA.
- [Account security](https://docs.gandi.net/en/account_security/): Overview of account protection and authentication features.

## Support and Help
- [Documentation home](https://docs.gandi.net/en/): Main portal for Gandi product and service documentation.
- [Help center](https://help.gandi.net/hc/en-us): Support portal for troubleshooting and customer assistance.
- [Domain names help articles](https://help.gandi.net/hc/en-us/categories/115000242409-Domain-Names): Support articles focused on domain management topics.
- [DNS and nameserver help articles](https://help.gandi.net/hc/en-us/search?query=DNS): Search results for DNS-related support content.
- [Contact support](https://help.gandi.net/hc/en-us/requests/new): Entry point for submitting support requests.

## Product and Service Overview
- [Gandi main site](https://www.gandi.net/): Main website for Gandi products, services, and account access.
- [Domain names](https://www.gandi.net/en/domain): Product overview for domain registration and management.
- [DNS hosting](https://www.gandi.net/en/domain/email-dns): Overview of DNS and email services associated with domains.
- [Cloud hosting](https://www.gandi.net/en/cloud): Product information for Gandi cloud infrastructure services.
- [Simple hosting](https://www.gandi.net/en/simple-hosting): Overview of managed web hosting offerings.
